summary.intent: Review the 27 pending GSD todos after pulling latest main, verify which were silently resolved by recent PRs (#541/#543), archive the confirmed-resolved ones, and identify thematic groupings for upcoming work.
summary.outcome: A 35-agent adversarial audit confirmed 6 todos fully resolved by PRs #541 (API IPFS hardening) and #543 (FUSE/IPNS durability), 2 partially resolved with specific residual gaps. The 6 archived todos were git-moved to completed/ on a docs branch with PR annotations. The remaining 21 todos were clustered into actionable themes for upcoming phases.

repo: PRs #541 and #543 (merged 2026-06-22) silently closed 6 pending todos without any todo archival — the 'resolved without archive' problem recurs; periodic audits are necessary.

Phase 58 / PRs #538/#543/#544 all churn the same ~5 FUSE files (verify.rs, events.rs, metadata.rs, content_ops.rs, publish.rs, replay.rs) — these files are the highest-churn durability-critical surface in the repo.
IPNS verification spans 4 layers (FUSE, SDK, API, desktop) and the first-publish embedded-sequence convention is inconsistent between FUSE (starts at 0) and SDK (starts at 1) — #21 is unresolved.
The ERC-1271 contract wallet feature is entirely unbuilt: siwe.service.ts is EOA-only with no publicClient, no eth_getCode, no isValidSignature fallback.
Faro transport is defined (registerFaroTransport in faro.ts:177) but has zero call sites — the observability wiring was never completed.
The web search index (buildFromFolderTree) is fully synchronous with a blocking miniSearch.addAll() call — no chunking, no Worker, no incremental updates.

FUSE fs.rs has an asymmetry: the Folder branch (153-157) was hardened in #543 to propagate wrap_key errors, but the File branch (225-227) still uses .ok() and silently drops the error, publishing ipns_private_key_encrypted: None.

code.finding: verifyMessage called without publicClient — EOA-only, no ERC-1271 contract wallet fallback. Comments at lines 40 and 70 explicitly document this limitation.
buildFromFolderTree() is fully synchronous: builds flat documents[] and calls miniSearch.addAll() in one blocking shot. No chunking, no Web Worker, no incremental add/remove.
Logger calls console.* directly with no transports[] array and no redact() interceptor — PII in warn/error logs is never filtered.
registerFaroTransport is defined here but has zero call sites anywhere in apps/web.
Calls initFaro() but never calls registerFaroTransport — Faro transport is initialized but never wired to the logger.
cmdStateCompletePhase never writes a terminal Current Position ('Plan: M of M — COMPLETE') on the milestone's final phase, causing STATE.md regression.
updatePerformanceMetricsSection does a cumulative newTotal = prevTotal + summaryCount with no milestone-aware recompute, causing inflated velocity metrics across milestones.
File-side re-resolution triggers only on modified_at change, not on a changed file_meta_ipns_name — a file can retain stale CID/keys after IPNS name rotation.
File branch uses .ok() to silently drop wrap_key errors, publishing ipns_private_key_encrypted: None. The sibling Folder branch (153-157) was hardened in #543 but the File branch was not.

workflow: gsd_run query init.todos emits a warning to stderr that pollutes JSON parsing — always capture stdout independently from stderr when consuming its output.
Todo files that open with a `# Heading` instead of YAML frontmatter (--- created/title/area ---) are invisible to --list (show as 'Untitled', no area, no age) — all todos must have valid frontmatter.
Workflow args passed as a JSON array can arrive as a stringified string inside the workflow script, breaking array methods — hardcoding the list in the script body is a reliable workaround.
Adversarial re-check (independent second agent trying to refute 'resolved' verdicts) significantly improves confidence before archiving todos — worth the extra agent cost on irreversible moves.
Multi-agent audit of 27 todos with adversarial verification took ~4 minutes wall-clock with 35 agents and 301 tool uses — viable as a periodic hygiene step after major PR merges.

friction: gsd_run query init.todos stderr warning polluted JSON output on the first parse attempt, requiring a second clean-stdout-only invocation.
Two todo files (#26 desktop E2E recycle-bin, #27 FUSE CAS dead param) had no YAML frontmatter, rendering them as 'Untitled / general / no age' in --list — a persistent capture format inconsistency.
Workflow args arrived as a string instead of an array when passed to the audit workflow, forcing a re-run with the file list hardcoded directly in the script.
6 todos were stale-resolved with no signal — PRs #541 and #543 fixed them without any automated todo cross-referencing, making manual audit necessary.
open_items: FUSE inode.rs:574 — file-side re-resolution gap: stale CID/keys if file_meta_ipns_name changes but modified_at does not (partial resolution of todo #13).
FUSE fs.rs:225-227 — File branch wrap_key error silently dropped with .ok(), publishing ipns_private_key_encrypted: None (partial resolution of todo #16, the one unfixed finding).

Frontmatter repair for todos #26 (2026-06-22-desktop-e2e-recycle-bin-test-parity-sh-vs-ps1.md) and #27 (2026-06-22-fuse-cas-helper-dead-param-and-content-ops-cleanup.md) — both committed without YAML frontmatter.
4 stale feature todos (ERC-1271 wallet auth 129d, CRDT IPNS inbox 121d, async search index 118d, alt MFA 116d) recommended for --backlog promotion to declutter the active list.
Theme A (FUSE IPNS verify/publish long-tail: ~8 todos touching verify.rs/events.rs/metadata.rs/content_ops.rs) identified as highest-value next phase — not yet scheduled.
GSD tooling: state.cjs cmdStateCompletePhase still regresses STATE.md on a milestone's final phase (todo #5, gsd-tools internal).
